rationale: The central diagnosis, mechanism, rollback evidence, and recommended remediation match the evidence and all required findings. It appropriately rejects database, CPU, and PDF-ticket explanations. Some causal details overreach the evidence, including attributing CPU to retries, asserting impact confinement to legacy traffic, and inferring an uncaught production-process failure; these are mostly caveated in the uncertainty section. Actions are well prioritized and target the adapter mapping and prevention controls.
